THREE scorecards, because a shared mechanism is not shared coverage. Judgments authored; every fact derived from a pinned artifact at run time. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f16_f18_written_bar_assessment.py

standard.item2_bar: enumerated, scoped to relevant (NOT an empty unresolved set)
standard.vocabulary: bounded-exhausted remains a STOP DECISION and never reads as met; these three rows declare their next as 'Bounded.', which is therefore a disposition and is not counted anywhere here

authority.author_conflict: the assessor did not author this campaign's evidence but is the same agent line that authored the measurement standard and the F01 exemplar it is applied through; met_candidate is a submission, not a met

cross_credit_guard.risk: F16/F17/F18 share one mechanism and carry an identical missing/fixture_need/next block, so one row's evidence reads as three rows' evidence unless the ownership is enforced
cross_credit_guard.artifact_ownership_derived_from: each artifact's own `row` field, not its filename

handtyped_number_guard.rule: every numeric or hex token in an authored basis/gap must appear in the derived-fact table for that row

unmeasured_probe.rule: a dimension with NO evidence to measure against must be scored `unmeasured`, which is a different verdict from measured absence
unmeasured_probe.note: the probe was applied to all nine dimensions on all three rows and found registered evidence everywhere, so `unmeasured` was available and correctly went unused. That is itself a finding: these rows are evidence-rich and their `partial` registry status is not caused by missing evidence. The one place the word still applies is scoped inside source_closure -- the shared bonus overlay lies outside the source map's address range, so the overlay half of that dimension has no registry to be measured against at all.

per_row_differences._comment: The specific risk in this assessment was crediting one row's evidence to its siblings. These are the measured differences; identical STATES do not mean identical COVERAGE.
